reason: Verified in source and in the driven page, and every checkable claim holds. lock.md and elevate.config.json declare a 13-step type ramp, an 8-step radius ladder and a 4-step duration ladder, and no tracking ladder; audit.mjs has no letter-spacing check and lessons.md has no tracking class, so this is neither already handled nor a restatement of a gate. Driving all eleven approach states at 1440 returns five distinct trackings on 11px uppercase Geist Mono — 0.99px (.b-behindDate/.b-grab/.b-foot/.b-switch span, 80 nodes), 1.21px (.b-date, 35), 1.43px (.b-where/.b-label/.b-ogDate, 9), 1.76px (.b-todayLabel/.b-behindLabel/.b-measureHead, 16), 2.2px (.b-who/.b-ogWho, 11) — and two at 12px (1.92px .b-unit, 3.6px .b-dayToday). The owner-flight adjacency is exact and is the same face at the same size: .b-measureHead 'DAYS AWAY' 0.16em heads the column, .b-date 'SAT 1 AUG' 0.11em sits inside the item, .b-grab 'SHOWN' 0.09em sits directly under it. The sans case is the sharpest evidence: .b-when and .b-dayDate both render F.fmt.longYear(), both 20px/400, one at -0.3px and one at normal — identical string, identical size, two trackings — and both 48px/600 headings do render in the same sweep at two values (.b-pressTitle -1.44px, .b-dayNames -1.68px). With three colours and two weights, tracking is one of the few hierarchy tools this direction has left, so leaving it undeclared and hand-set per component is a real systemic gap at a 9.5 bar. The finding's '511 instances' is a cross-room, cross-width total I did not reproduce (151 at 1440 in the approach room) and is not load-bearing. The fix as written needs sharpening: one label step would flatten deliberate hierarchy, --track-display: -0.045em is calibrated for a tabular count and would over-tighten a 48px sans sentence, --track-body: 0 would loosen the item titles that are the densest text on the measure, and the values belong in elevate.config.json, not hard-coded into the shared skill script.
sharpenedFix: Declare the ladder as data, not as a rule rewrite. (1) Add `ladders.tracking` to elevate.config.json next to typeRamp — audit.mjs already reads every other ladder as `config.ladders?.*`, so the values must live in the lab's config and only the generic check goes in audit.mjs, mirroring the radii check; the finding's 'add the ladder to audit.mjs' aims at the wrong file. (2) Six steps, not five, and keep the two that are doing work: `--track-label: 0.16em` (default uppercase mono micro-label — .b-date, .b-behindDate, .b-grab, .b-foot, .b-switch span, .b-where, .b-label, .b-ogDate, .b-measureHead, .b-todayLabel, .b-behindLabel, .b-unit all collapse here), `--track-labelWide: 0.20em` (the ceremonial top-line only — .b-who, .b-ogWho, .b-dayToday; at 11px with no colour and no third weight, wide tracking is the only thing separating 'MARA & FINN' from a row label, and flattening it to 0.16em trades this defect for a flatter horizon), `--track-data: 0.04em` (mono figures and fields — .b-stepRead, .b-input[data-mono]; note .b-date is an uppercase label, not data, so it takes --track-label), `--track-body: -0.015em` (sans 15–20px — keep the optical tightening the titles already have rather than resetting to 0, and set .b-dayDate to this token so it matches .b-when, which is the one unambiguous bug here), `--track-head: -0.03em` (sans 24–38px — .b-emptyTitle, .b-pressTitle, .b-endedTitle), `--track-display: -0.045em` (96/148px .b-num only). Give 48px its own value rather than folding it into display: set .b-pressTitle and .b-dayNames both to -0.035em, since -0.045em is tuned for three tabular digits and will collide letters in 'Send it to Mara & Finn.' (3) Replace every hand-set letter-spacing in b.css with one of these tokens, define them in shell.css beside the ramp, record them in lock.md's mechanical lock, and re-shoot the eleven states — .b-who dropping 0.04em and .b-dayToday dropping 0.14em change measured widths on the horizon and the day card, so both frames need re-checking for reflow before the ladder is called done.
